items.title: Post Production Project Manager
items.jd_full:
• Strong English Fluency. All work will be done in English.
  • Experience managing contractors or employees
  • A track record of setting clear expectations and getting projects delivered on time
  • Clear, confident written communication, since most of the work happens over email

Video editing experience is a huge plus. You'll know the terminology, know how to give creative notes to editors, and be able to jump in on light edits.
